package.name: RibLoft
package.description: Parametric lofts through corresponding wires of multi-wire profiles. Wires are paired between consecutive profiles with the Hungarian algorithm and corner-matched automatically, so rotated, re-ordered or re-drawn sections do not produce twisted lofts. Typical use: ribs, frames and stringers lofted between multi-wire section sketches.
package.author: Alex Dremov

workbench.name: RibLoft
workbench.description: Parametric lofts through corresponding wires of multi-wire profiles (optimal wire pairing + automatic corner matching).
